visual_review: Final 1200px render inspected: complete object framing, readable interlacing, continuous ochre float, clean background and no visible collisions or broken edges. Fine residual render grain remains.

geometry_summary.check_scope: BVH surface-overlap check between every warp/weft pair, and crossing-center height checks. No material mechanics or stress simulation.

limitations: Digital geometry and rendered material study, not a physically validated paper craft pattern.
No paper stiffness, tension, gravity deformation or contact-stability simulation.
BVH check covers evaluated warp/weft surface pairs; crossing-center clearances are not global minimum distances.
